basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old audio technician from Melbourne, Australia, with a passion for both music and birds. My work involves setting up sound systems for events, which has fueled my interest in how sound interacts with different environments. I'm new to keeping budgies and am eager to see how they respond to various genres of music. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings between 7-10 PM after work. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring new hobbies, like building Balisong clones or modding games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a diploma in Audio Engineering and have been working in the field for about 5 years. My interest in music and sound is both professional and personal. I often delve into self-teaching through online courses and forums to stay updated with the latest technologies in audio equipment.
